objective: Prove, for parity laws C1 and C2 and their product law (allowed states: arrays whose columns are allowed states of C1 and whose rows are allowed states of C2): (1) a knot of C1 through p, p' and a knot of C2 through q, q' give an L-shaped knot of the product through (p,q) and (p',q') with |K1| + |K2| - 2 places, so bond distance <= delta1 + delta2 - 1; (2) the product of two two-way threads has dense finite moves (no ends), so by LOGIC-AXIS A it splits and its bond distance grows at least linearly with separation; with (1), bond distance is comparable to taxicab distance and bond balls grow like r^2: a plane of dimension two built from two logical number lines. Check exact equality delta1 + delta2 - 1 on finite products by exhaustive search.
status: Proved (OPEN-END-GROWTH-20261107-001C-P001): the logical Cartesian plane. In the product law of two parity laws (arrays whose columns and rows are allowed states of the axes), a knot of each axis joined at a corner gives an L-shaped knot of |K1|+|K2|-2 places, so bond distance <= delta1+delta2-1; the product of two two-way threads has no ends, so it splits and its bond distance is within constants of taxicab distance, with bond balls growing like r^2: a plane of dimension two built from two logical number lines. Exact equality delta1+delta2-1 conjectured (855 pairs, no exception).
title: The logical Cartesian plane: the product of two number lines
